generator.description: optional: name of a generator in core/engine/gen (e.g. door). It builds shapes + ports from the parameters, so shapes/ports in this json can stay empty

tags.description: pipe, concrete, host (can carry rebar), furniture, valve ... A part tagged pipe with a numeric parameter len (mm) gets a length in the bill of materials

bom.description: optional, bill of materials: { ignore: [parameter names] } = parameters that only turn / pose the part or set its reinforcement (bend turn, door open angle ...), so they do not split a BOM line

parameters.description: {min,max,step,default,label,short,unit} for numbers; {options:[value | {v,label}],default} for choices (design, glass, handle ...). values in shapes can use $param expressions

shapes.description: collision/visual primitives: {id,role:solid|void|clearance,type:box|cylinder,size|radius+length,axis,at,rot (box: euler deg; cylinder: turns it after axis),accepts[], color (0xRRGGBB, optional), opacity (0-1, optional)}

children.description: composite only: [{component, id, params, pos, rot}]

ports.description: connection points {id,at,dir,type,DN/OD,PN} - mate two ports to snap + check compatibility

reinforcement.description: which rebar templates this host accepts

geometry.description: how the 3D mesh is generated (generator js / parametric html), separate from collision shapes
